sampling_safety.reason: Root authorized exact-profile private assembly after source inspection and actual native r3 non-mipmap linear/anisotropy1 sampler constraints. Literal probe rendered in prior native pilot and regressed; pixel parity/moving quality and incremental benefit remain unaccepted.
sampling_safety.scope: Private measured-profile experiment only. First full-screen draw per numeric GL program ID; no universal derivative/parity/sampler completeness proof. Other profiles, samplers, versions and changing runtime state require review.

initial_safety_finding.reason: New count dispatch encloses implicit texture reads; final bound sampler/filter/anisotropy state and derivative independence are not verified for every density sampler.
initial_safety_finding.scope: Design preview only; disabled/original assemblies preserve B15 shader bytes.
